summary.headline: Father’s Length of Life
summary.text: Chapter XVII explains how to judge the length of the father’s life from the Sun, Saturn, the Ascendant, the angles, planetary years, house lords, and the part of the fathers; it then begins Chapter XVIII on the length of the mother’s life.
